If Matthew Stafford announces his retirement from the NFL before the 2026-27 NFL season start date, then the market resolves to Yes. Note: The retirement must be intended to be effective immediately or prior to the first new season after the announcement.

For the purposes of this market, the NFL season start date is defined as the date of the first regular season game for that season.

edge_board.description: Trader consensus at 96% against a Chinese invasion of Taiwan by the end of 2026 reflects the absence of large-scale amphibious mobilization or command restructuring needed for such an operation, reinforced by U.S. intelligence assessments that Beijing prioritizes non-military unification and lacks a fixed timeline. Ongoing gray-zone tactics, including stable China Coast Guard patrols and routine PLA activity around Taiwan, continue without crossing into open conflict. Taiwan's July 2026 urban defense drills and coastal command enhancements, alongside Xi Jinping's military leadership purges that have disrupted PLA operational readiness, further reduce near-term invasion risks. Diplomatic summits between U.S. and Chinese leaders have kept tensions contained. Late escalations from miscalculation, Taiwanese actions perceived as provocative, or rapid shifts in external alliances remain the primary variables that could still influence the outcome before year-end.
edge_board.question: Will China invade Taiwan by end of 2026?
edge_board.resolution_criteria:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China commences a military offensive intended to establish control over any portion of the Republic of China (Taiwan) by December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

Territory under the administration of the Republic of China including any inhabited islands will qualify, however uninhabited islands will not qualify. 

The resolution source for this market will be will be official confirmation by China, Taiwan, the United Nations, or any permanent member of the UN Security Council, however a consensus of credible reporting will also be used.

edge_board.description: Harry Kane's commanding lead in the 2026 Ballon d'Or market stems from his record-breaking 2025-26 club campaign at Bayern Munich, where he delivered exceptional goal output alongside domestic honors, followed by six World Cup goals that helped England reach the semifinals. Traders view this combination of sustained club dominance and major-tournament impact as the decisive edge. Lamine Yamal sits second on the back of another strong Barcelona season and consistent Spain performances, while Kylian Mbappé, Rodri, and Lionel Messi trail due to strong but comparatively less decisive club or national-team contributions in the calendar year. Recent World Cup results and individual tallies have anchored current implied probabilities, with Kane's form the clearest differentiator in crowd-sourced pricing.
edge_board.question: Will Lionel Messi win the 2026 Ballon d'Or?
edge_board.resolution_criteria:
This market will resolve according to the winner of the 2026 Ballon d’Or.

If no 2026 Ballon d’Or winner is declared by December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

The primary resolution source for this market is official information from France Football (https://www.francefootball.fr/).

edge_board.description: Freddie Mac
edge_board.question: When will Freddie Mac officially announce an IPO?
edge_board.resolution_criteria: If Freddie Mac confirms an IPO before Aug 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes. An IPO is confirmed if 1) the SEC declares the company's Form S-1 effective OR 2) the IPO is priced OR 3) a securities exchange has assigned a ticker to it. As long as any of those events occur, the market will immediately resolve to Yes, even if the company does not start trading until after Aug 1, 2026.

edge_board.description: Corporate announcement
edge_board.question: Will any company announce that it has achieved Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) before Oct 1, 2026?
edge_board.resolution_criteria: If any company (public or private) officially announces that it has achieved Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) after market issuance and before Oct 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes. To qualify, the announcement must explicitly state that the company has achieved, attained, reached, or developed Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), or that it has achieved, attained, reached, or developed “AGI.” Statements that describe “AGI-like,” “AGI-level,” “near-AGI,” or “toward AGI” systems without explicitly stating that the company has achieved/attained/reached/developed AGI do not qualify. For purposes of this market, a “company” includes any publicly traded company or any privately held company whose existence and corporate identity is verifiable and whose financing/valuation or corporate profile is covered by at least two of the listed major business news sources.

edge_board.resolution_criteria: If Congress successfully overrides a Presidential veto before Aug 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
